title: Caramelized Andouille Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish featuring caramelized andouille sausage and a hint of sweetness from caramel.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced andouille sausage to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the cooked sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the diced Ukrainian kissed potatoes to the skillet and cook until they begin to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the melted caramel to the skillet and stir to combine with the potatoes.
Return the cooked sausage to the skillet and stir to combine with the potatoes and caramel.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
